title: ON Semiconductor Shares Jump After Earnings and Outlook Beat Expectations
excerpt: ON Semiconductor (NASDAQ:ON) shares climbed 7. 6% in pre-market trading after the chipmaker reported second-quarter 2026 results that exceeded Wall Street fo...
content_html:
ON Semiconductor (NASDAQ:ON) shares climbed 7.6% in pre-market trading after the chipmaker reported second-quarter 2026 results that exceeded Wall Street forecasts and issued a stronger-than-expected outlook for the current quarter.

The company posted non-GAAP earnings of $0.74 per share, ahead of analyst expectations of $0.71, while revenue reached $1.60 billion, slightly above the consensus estimate of $1.59 billion. Sales also increased 9% compared with the same period last year.

Margin Expansion Continues

ON Semiconductor delivered another quarter of improving profitability, with its non-GAAP gross margin increasing by 80 basis points from the previous quarter to 39.3%.

The latest result marked the fourth consecutive quarter of sequential gross margin expansion.

Cash generation also remained strong, with operating cash flow improving significantly and free cash flow reaching $425.4 million during the quarter.

Third-Quarter Forecast Tops Consensus

Investor sentiment received an additional boost after management issued guidance that exceeded market expectations.

ON Semiconductor expects third-quarter revenue of between $1.65 billion and $1.75 billion, with the midpoint of $1.70 billion sitting above analysts' consensus forecast of approximately $1.67 billion.

The company also expects gross margin to improve further, forecasting a range of 40% to 42% for the third quarter.

AI Demand Continues to Drive Growth

Chief Executive Hassane El-Khoury highlighted artificial intelligence infrastructure as the company's fastest-growing business.

"AI data centers remain our fastest-growing segment, and we now expect revenue to double in 2026," he said, pointing to new partnerships with NVIDIA MGX, Great Wall and AWS.

The company also repurchased $332 million of its own shares during the quarter, a move that signals management's confidence in the business and its long-term prospects.

Technology Rally Adds to Positive Momentum

The broader market environment also supported semiconductor stocks.

The Nasdaq gained 0.7%, while the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average each advanced 0.2%, extending the technology sector's recovery after a volatile July. The previous trading session had already seen a broad-based rally in technology shares, creating a favourable backdrop ahead of ON Semiconductor's earnings announcement.

Following the results, ON Semiconductor shares traded around $86.50 in pre-market dealings, well above the previous closing price of $80.40. Although the stock remains below its 52-week high of $134.92, it has staged a strong recovery from its 52-week low of $44.56.

content_html_zh:
安森美半导体 (NASDAQ:ON) 公布的 2026 年第二季度业绩超出华尔街预期，并发布了强于预期的本季度前景，该公司股价在盘前交易中上涨 7.6%。

该公司公布的非 GAAP 每股收益为 0.74 美元，高于分析师预期的 0.71 美元，而营收达到 16 亿美元，略高于市场普遍预期的 15.9 亿美元。 销售额也比去年同期增长了9%。

利润率持续扩大

安森美半导体第三季度盈利能力有所改善，非公认会计准则毛利率较上一季度增长 80 个基点，达到 39.3%。

最新业绩标志着毛利率连续第四个季度环比增长。

现金生成也保持强劲，运营现金流显着改善，本季度自由现金流达到 4.254 亿美元。

第三季度预测最一致

在管理层发布超出市场预期的指引后，投资者情绪进一步提振。

安森美半导体预计第三季度营收在 16.5 亿美元至 17.5 亿美元之间，中间值为 17.0 亿美元，高于分析师一致预测的约 16.7 亿美元。

该公司还预计第三季度毛利率将进一步提高，预计在 40% 至 42% 之间。

人工智能需求持续推动增长

首席执行官 Hassane El-Khoury 强调人工智能基础设施是公司增长最快的业务。

他表示：“人工智能数据中心仍然是我们增长最快的领域，我们现在预计收入将在 2026 年翻一番。”他指的是与 NVIDIA MGX、长城和 AWS 的新合作伙伴关系。

该公司还在本季度回购了价值 3.32 亿美元的自有股票，此举表明管理层对公司业务及其长期前景充满信心。

技术反弹增添积极势头

更广泛的市场环境也支撑了半导体股票。

纳斯达克指数上涨 0.7%，标准普尔 500 指数和道琼斯工业平均指数均上涨 0.2%，延续了科技板块在经历了 7 月份的波动后的复苏。 前一交易日科技股已经普遍上涨，为安森美半导体公布财报创造了有利的背景。

公布结果后，安森美半导体股价在盘前交易中的交易价格约为 86.50 美元，远高于之前 80.40 美元的收盘价。 尽管该股仍低于 134.92 美元的 52 周高点，但已从 44.56 美元的 52 周低点强劲反弹。
